title: vtc-00: stopped livestream cannot restart
description: Pre-existing: vtc-00 says a stopped push livestream's config 'may be updated for a future stream', but the state machine has no transition out of stopped or failed, so nothing can restart it. xpzz worded around it ('defines no transition out of'). Decide: (a) allow stopped/failed -> starting on a start request, or (b) terminal states; a new stream is a new VTCLivestream, and drop the 'future stream' sentence. Recommendation: (b), constraint over mechanism; create is cheap.
close_reason: Mark 2026-10-30: final states; create a new VTCLivestream to stream again
